analysis: The PR only modifies docs/developer/test.md, adding a 'Provider authorization guidance' section at head lines 76-87. The two supplied units (lines 919-1842) are unchanged surrounding documentation, not the changed range. Reviewed anyway for security-relevant statements. The added section describes running ProviderAuthorizationReadinessTests (freshness checks, receipt-window boundary, lease expiry, removal advice requiring a matching fresh decision) using fixed snapshots and injected process identity. It states explicitly that these do not establish native App Attest acceptance, so there is no overclaim relative to T-052/T-053/T-054/T-057 (TB-011). No code, protocol, key handling, cache (T-041), watchdog (T-043), fan helper (TB-010) or add-on hold (TB-012) behavior changes. No new attack surface, no changed secrets, no invalidated assumptions. Remaining uncertainty: the production code the test suite exercises (status/doctor authorization summary) is not in the supplied evidence, so whether its freshness logic is correct cannot be assessed here; the doc change itself does not alter any control.
